shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture, soft natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on clothing, badges, book spines and walls. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the person, both hands and everything the sentence depends on inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.bookcase: The setting is a bright, quiet neighborhood library with a plain white wall and a warm wooden floor. One tall light-oak bookcase with six shelves, about 2.2 meters high, stands against the wall in the center of the photo, filled with books whose spines are plain solid colors without any lettering. The camera is at chest height a few steps back and shows the whole bookcase from the floor to its top and the person's whole body from head to feet, so the person's height is easy to judge against the shelves.
shared_prompts.mexico_house: Keep the house exactly as in Image 1: the terracotta-orange walls, the open dark-green wooden doors, the terracotta tiled path and the pink bougainvillea at the far left. Sunny afternoon light. The flag and the suitcase are not in this photo.

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Sofia. Keep her face, warm brown skin and build exactly. Her long curly dark hair is now pulled up into a neat high bun, so no hair falls on her shoulders or back. She stands on tiptoe right beside the bookcase and stretches one arm straight up as high as she can toward a red book on the top shelf, but her fingertips stop clearly below the top shelf; the top of her head is level with the third shelf from the top. The top shelf is obviously out of her reach: she is short.
